name: The report returns to Darnassus

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Thyn’tel receives the report and calls the account Velinde’s fate. She recalls a trusted friend and accepts that the Scythe has passed out of her people’s hands. Her thanks closes the nine-step chain, but the mystery remains open: the quest does not recover the weapon, identify whoever may have found it, or explain the later fate of every worgen pack. Darnassus can record the loss. It cannot tell the seeker where the Scythe went.
